loss_contract.teacher_capture: store per-token top-64 logits plus eight BF16 2048-wide bridge hidden states; teacher never co-resides with student

memory_envelope.activation_contract: microbatch=1, sequence=1024, gradient_checkpointing=true, FlashAttention2, no teacher co-residency
memory_envelope.single_gpu_requirement: 80GB H100/H200 class; L40S 48GB is excluded for BF16 recovery

quality_separation: No frozen development or holdout record was read for training. The development suite is only an after-training gate; no static/synthetic preflight is quality evidence.

quantization_contract.base: merge LoRA into the mapped BF16 student, then run the pinned compressed-tensors AWQ group-32 W4 conversion

trainable_contract.method: BF16 LoRA rank-16 on retained q_a_proj, q_b_proj, o_proj, and sparse MoE router gate; all base tensors frozen
